remedy.justification: net 'NB,VIN' exceeds the antenna-ratio limit at 'li1' (ratio 285 > 75); no adjacent stackup level has margin to absorb the excess routing (a layer-local violation with no jump target) -- insert an antenna diode on this net at 'li1' to bleed off accumulated charge
